title: debug - 2f6c9904
description:
## Analysis of the Bug

The error `RuntimeError: value cannot be converted to type at::Half without overflow` occurs because `-1e9` is used as a mask fill value in the custom attention pooling layer when the model is under mixed precision (`autocast`). In FP16, the minimum representable value is around -65504, so -1e9 causes overflow. The fix is to replace `-1e9` with a value that works in FP16 range, like `-1e4` or better, use `-float('inf')` which will be handled correctly by PyTorch's softmax.

## Code Fix
